title: Margaya Tu Bhai
body:
Halq par kund chori, jab rakha shumr shaqi margaya tu bhai x 2
Tera wo sukha gala, saamne katta raha, paani main dena saki Margaya tu bhai
Hay who waqte asar rohte the gin o basher,
margaya bhai mera rohti thi peetke sar,
Pao ab tujhko kahan rohte hai arzo sama
Hay kuch karna saki margaya tu bhai,
Baandhe hai baad tere mere baazo pe rasan,
Maa ko dikhlaungi mein jaungi jab main watan,
Daag seene pe liye roti hai tere liye,
Kis liye jeeti rahi margaya tu bhai,
Tujhpe bhai main fida mera kaaliq hai gawa,
Maine bacho ko mere kardiye tujh pe fida,
Tu magar bach na saka laut kar aana saka,
Rohti hai behna teri margaya tu bhai,
Jaake bhai main watan kis tarha maa se kahon,
Tere bin bhai mere Tanha kaise mai jeeyu,
Saath hai kurta tera hai magar khoon se bhara,
Hay taqdeer meri margaya tu bhai,
Saath Abid tha mere Pehne ek toq e giran
Pusht par durre lagge Hai nishaan usske aayan,
Ek bimaar kahan toq o zanjeer kahan,
Rah kaaton ki rahi margaya tu bhai,
Noke naize pe rahe sarre shawdae ke sarr,
Na teher ta tha kabhi bhai Abbas ka Sarr,
Sarr ko wo mere kulle kaise wo dekhe mujhe,
Berida chalti rahi margaya tu bhai.
Bhai bachi ko teri main bacha bhi na saki,
Har gadi zulm naya sabr se sehti rahi,
Apne ammu ko kabhi anpe baba ko kabhi,
Yaad karti wo rahi margaya tu bhai,
Laasha uriya tha tera garm rethi pe pada,
Rohne wala na koi, Teri behna ke siwa,
Para para tha badan roti thi teri behan,
Main kafan dena saki margaya tu bhai,
Sunke ashaare taqi rohte hai ahle aza,
Bhai mazloom mera dega tum sab ko dua,
Ashke momin ke liye apna rumaal liye,
Aagayi Amma meri margaya tu bhai.
